target_candidate.claim_under_test: entity_state.generation is the sole live generation/CAS authority and eos_pipeline_state is continuity-only bookkeeping

current_main_discriminator.requirement: once reference effect/profile parity turns current, eos_pipeline_state must not retain generation or participate in a second generation/CAS authority

R0_OBSERVE: PR #966 creates entity_state.generation and reads it in pipeline_state_read.
_ensure_schema computes migrated_generation=max(entity_state.generation,eos_pipeline_state.generation) and writes the maximum back to both tables.
_pipeline_commit advances entity_state with a generation CAS and then separately advances eos_pipeline_state with a second generation CAS.
current main added a fail-closed invariant that rejects reference PARITY if eos_pipeline_state retains generation or a second CAS path.
grf.R1_INFER: The eos_pipeline_state generation is not a passive mirror: it can change canonical entity_state generation during schema convergence and can independently veto a commit. Therefore the candidate has two operational generation authorities.
R2_GENERATE: H1: mirror generation is harmless compatibility metadata.
H2: mirror generation is a second authority because it can drive canonical generation or independently reject commit.
H3: one-time legacy migration can preserve historical generation without keeping a live second authority.
grf.R3_COUNTER: Strongest defense of H1: both updates occur in one SQLite transaction, so divergence should normally be impossible after convergence. Counterpoint: upgrade state can already be divergent, the max() rule explicitly lets the legacy mirror overwrite canonical generation, and the second CAS remains a separate acceptance condition even after convergence.

R4_DISCRIMINATE.scope: bounded isolated SQLite mechanism reproduction of the exact max(native,mirror) migration law; no repository/product/provider mutation

grf.R5_EMERGENT: Compatibility state becomes authority whenever it can monotonically advance canonical state or independently gate canonical commit. Transactional co-location does not erase semantic authority duplication.

required: Treat entity_state.generation as the only live generation/CAS source after convergence.
Remove generation from the live eos_pipeline_state schema and remove mirror generation CAS from pipeline_commit.

For an upgrade DB where entity_state did not exist but legacy eos_pipeline_state generation did exist, permit exactly one explicit migration seed into newly-created entity_state before retiring the legacy generation field.
If entity_state already existed before migration, never let a legacy mirror value advance or overwrite it.
Rebuild legacy eos_pipeline_state to continuity/canonical/cursor fields only, atomically and fail-closed.
Run the current-main generation-authority invariant together with #966 focused reference regressions on exact repaired bytes.
forbidden: second live generation CAS on eos_pipeline_state
marking NATIVE_PROFILE_V2_PARITY_CONTRACT reference status PARITY while parallel generation authority remains

runner_attempt.rule: queued or pre-step failure is not executable PASS or semantic FAIL

next_exact_gate: Repair #966 so legacy generation is one-time migration input only and entity_state is the sole live generation/CAS authority; then execute the current-main invariant plus focused/adjacent reference tests on exact repaired branch bytes in an actually-started authorized runner.
